description: This file defines the Store model class in the Opencart admin module. It provides methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving store records in the database, as well as creating store instances with a full registry setup. The class handles interactions with multiple related models like layout, seo_url, category, product, and others, to manage the store's associated data.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Model class for managing store entities in the OpenCart admin system, including CRUD operations and store-specific registry initialization.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Creates a new store record in the database and initializes related routes and SEO URLs. Returns the new store's ID.

methods.name: editStore
methods.description: Updates an existing store record in the database.

methods.name: deleteStore
methods.description: Deletes a store and all associated data such as categories, information, manufacturers, products, GDPR data, themes, translations, SEO URLs, settings, and localization data.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Retrieves a store's data by its ID. Returns default data if ID is 0.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all stores, optionally filtered with start and limit for pagination.

methods.name: getTotalStores
methods.description: Returns the total number of stores in the database.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the count of stores associated with a specific layout ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByLanguage
methods.description: Returns the count of stores configured with a specific language.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCurrency
methods.description: Returns the count of stores configured with a specific currency.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCountryId
methods.description: Returns the count of stores associated with a specific country ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByZoneId
methods.description: Returns the count of stores associated with a specific zone ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCustomerGroupId
methods.description: Returns the count of stores associated with a specific customer group ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByInformationId
methods.description: Returns the total number of stores associated with specific information IDs.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByOrderStatusId
methods.description: Returns the number of stores associated with a specific order status ID.

methods.name: createStoreInstance
methods.description: Initializes and returns a full registry setup for a specific store, loading configuration, language, and other essential components.
